title: Tax Deed Sales | Flagler County Clerk of Court
summary: Rules for bidders: the winning bidder pays a non-refundable deposit of 5% of the final bid or $200, whichever is greater, and for online sales the deposit must be on file before the auction. Cashier's check, certified check, money order or cash; no personal or business checks. Photo ID required. Case files are on flagler.realtdm.com. Tax Deed line (386) 313-4375.

title: City of Bunnell announces special Commission meeting for De Novo hearing regarding Project Butterfly
summary: Media release. The Commission will rehear the Project Butterfly application on Oct. 28 at 9 a.m. after appeals of the Sept. 1 Planning, Zoning and Appeals Board decision. Order: staff, applicant, appellants (20 min), appellees (20 min), rebuttal (15 min), public comment, then decision. Notices mailed to owners within 500 feet.
